astral_dice.guide.category.blocks.desc: Blocks in this mod used to buy cards and chips and to recycle items. They can also be used as villager job site blocks. Interact with them by opening the interface.
astral_dice.guide.category.cards.desc: Cards come in battle cards and effect cards: battle cards slot into the dice card bar and occupy cost slots, granting points during the Blessing; effect cards have their own play count and cooldown.
Attack cards: consume one use on the attack that triggers the Dice Blessing and take effect, granting attack points in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.category.cards_defense: Defense cards: consume one use when you are hit and defend in a PvP dice battle, granting defense points.
Effect cards: grant various bonuses on use. Each play consumes one play count, and every play starts — and resets — a 45-second cooldown; the play count is restored when the cooldown ends, and is capped at §e9§7 per round.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips.desc: Chips are passive accessories granting attack, defense, speed, health and resource bonuses.
Chips tied to your Charge stacks: build Charge by moving, teleporting, killing and triggering the Dice Blessing, then convert it into attack, movement speed or skill-cooldown resets.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_healing: Chips tied to your healing state: they keep your health safe and grant offensive bonuses while your HP is plentiful.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_mark.de: Chips tied to applying the Mark status, providing steady bonuses for focus-fire playstyles.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_other.d: Chips that grant various other passives.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_starlig: Chips tied to your Starlight resource, handy for earning Star Coin profit.
astral_dice.guide.category.dice.desc: The dice is the core equipment: while equipped, melee attacks apply the Dice Blessing to you; card slot count is determined by the die's star level, and chip slot count by the die's tier and star level. Spend Star Coins on an anvil to star-up your dice and unlock more slots.
astral_dice.guide.category.getting_start: An accessory mod based on the Curios API. Equip dice, signs, chips and cards to gain buffs and combat abilities, and even pull off combo plays with your teammates.
astral_dice.guide.category.signs.desc: Signs grant character-flavored active and passive skills.

astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.1: With a dice equipped, melee attacks apply the Dice Blessing to you; attacks made under the Blessing enter an attack-versus-defense dice battle. Without a dice equipped it still resolves with the dice-battle formula (it no longer falls back to vanilla armor reduction), but both sides count their roll as 0. The attacker's roll and card bonuses count toward attack; the defender rolls a defense dice toward defense, and final damage = attack − defense (floor: 15%% of attack power, minimum 1).
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.2: Defense is computed per side: player defense = 4 + armor×0.30 + 0.85×toughness; mob defense = base defense + armor×0.40 + 1.0×toughness (rounded down); both then add defense dice and defense bonuses (1 defense = 2 armor). Defense dice are rolled only when the attacker also has a dice equipped; if either side has none, both count 0.
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.3: Upgrade a die on the anvil with Star Coins to raise its star level for stronger blessings and more card slots (0★=4, 1★=6, 2★=8, 3★=12, half attack/half defense); the base → golden → diamond → netherite chain unlocks more chip slots (card slots follow the star level only, identical across tiers at the same star; any die of the same tier can be used as the upgrade base).

astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_system_ch: Version 1.5.0 realigns combat resolution as a whole; this page sums up the parts that matter in play. Full rules for each system are on the Special Effects and Playstyles pages.

Dice-battle damage chain: attack power = attribute attack power × charge coefficient (the fuller the charge, the higher it gets) + weapon enchantment bonus damage + dice roll and card bonuses. The ×1.5 critical hit applies only to the attribute-attack-power × charge-coefficient segment — weapon enchantments, dice rolls and cards are never multiplied by it; on the defending side, Protection enchantments and Resistance now reduce the final damage proportionally.

Attack speed no longer affects dice battles: bonuses that only make you swing faster (such as the Perpetual Motion chip's -50%% melee cooldown) no longer raise dice-battle attack power at the same real charge rhythm — the coefficient follows charging time alone.

Extra damage channel: bonuses from the flashlight (by Starlight), the star-coin hammer, the cutter (by healing points), the eagle scope and the Cult Leader sign's Pursuit resolve as separate attack-damage instances right after the hit — they ignore the target's defense and receive no critical-hit or Full Power multipliers.

The four systems and their resources: Starlight (generation and spending, exchangeable at the card shop), Healing (a single layer pool settled when the blessing triggers and every 1:00 after), Marks (stack counts driving magic damage and extra damage) and Charge (player-level stacks, max 20, used to cap cooldowns and convert into attack power / movement speed).

Dodging and counterattacks: player-side dodge rolls are disabled — when one side can roll, the other must too, and when either side has no dice both roll 0 (final damage still follows the dice-battle formula instead of falling back to vanilla armor reduction); counterattacks are single damage instances triggered by the Pandaman sign's Taunt, the Gunsmith sign's Broken or the airbag's save, with no counterattack playstyle or stacks. Damage numbers: red = attack power and extra damage, green = spell and skill damage.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bonnie_sign.1: Active - Covert Operation: choose a hostile target and apply 1 Mark layer and Hidden Investigation to it; then gain Star Coins equal to the target's current Mark layers §e×2§7.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bonnie_sign.2: Passive Skill - Key Clue: +3 attack against marked targets; killing a marked hostile with at least 20 HP grants a random battle card; killing an Undercover Investigation target triggers the Investigation event.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bonnie_sign.3: Investigation event (4 stages, each 1:00): I — you and the applier gain Concealment; II — Concealment + +2 vs non-boss hostiles; III — Concealment + +(2+mark layers) vs non-boss hostiles; Truth revealed — you, the applier and your team (all players if you are not in a team) gain Concealment, +(2+marks) vs non-boss and +(2+marks×2) vs bosses. While concealed mobs cannot target you; attacking a mob breaks Concealment and adds damage equal to the target's mark layers in dice battles until the Investigation bonus ends.
astral_dice.guide.entry.buffer_shield_ch: When damaged, gain 2 healing layers and 3 Star Coins, once per 15 seconds.
astral_dice.guide.entry.candy_chip.1: Each effect card used grants +1 Healing layer and restores 1 health; at full health, this round's card slots +1 (at most once during the current play).
astral_dice.guide.entry.card_shop.1: Used to buy cards, transfer Star Coins to other players, and exchange your own Starlight for Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.card_trader.1: Villager profession "Card Trader"; its job site is the Card Shop (an unemployed villager takes it up there). Sells cards for Emeralds by level (2-20 Emeralds, better quality at higher levels) and unlocks "1 Emerald → 1 Star Coin" at level 3; while wearing the Emerald Die you can pay in Star Coins instead of Emeralds with a 20%% discount.
astral_dice.guide.entry.chip_shop.1: Open the interface to buy chips with Star Coins: 3 are offered at a time and the price starts at 10 Star Coins, rising by 5 per purchase (capped at 100); buying puts you on a 5:00 cooldown, and inserting a Blank Chip grants 1 extra re-roll (cap 5) and clears the purchase cooldown; inserting has its own 2:00 cooldown.
astral_dice.guide.entry.chip_trader.1: Villager profession "Chip Trader"; its job site is the Chip Shop (an unemployed villager takes it up there). Sells chips for Emeralds by level (2-20 Emeralds, better quality at higher levels) and unlocks "1 Emerald → 1 Star Coin" at level 3; the Emerald Die's Star Coin payment and 20%% discount apply here as well.
astral_dice.guide.entry.cursed_sword_chi: While equipped you always suffer the Blue Curse: Armor -20%%, Armor Toughness -50%%.
During a Dice Blessing, killing a hostile with at least 20 HP grants +1 attack (at most 1 per blessing), up to +32; removing the chip clears all bonuses and the Blue Curse.
Enigmatic Legacy+ link: while equipped, the Scroll of a Thousand Curses' curse count +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.cutter_blade_chi: At 60%% health or above, Attack Power +4, plus extra Attack Damage equal to your current healing layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.cutter_chip.1: At 60%% health or above, Attack Power +2, plus extra Attack Damage equal to your current healing layers.

astral_dice.guide.entry.defense_card_lar: Defense Card (Large): grants 1~6 defense power in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.entry.defense_card_med: Defense Card (Medium): grants 1~3 defense power in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.entry.diamond_dice.1: Diamond die. A higher tier that unlocks more chip slots; card slots follow the star level only (identical across tiers at the same star).
astral_dice.guide.entry.emerald_dice.1: Emerald die. Same tier as the diamond die and upgradeable from it; while equipped, villager trades use Star Coins instead of Emeralds with a 20%% discount.
astral_dice.guide.entry.event_drawer.1: Right-click to buy 1 Strange Question Mark for 5 Star Coins, limited to one purchase per 5:00 per player; too few Star Coins or an active cooldown is refused in red. Crafting recipe: 4 Star Plates and 4 Star Coins around 1 Diamond Dice (shaped 3×3).
astral_dice.guide.entry.event_ticket.1: Right-click to draw one random event from the public event pool; consumes 1 in Survival, none in Creative (stacks to 16). Bought from the Lottery Box for 5 Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.obsidian_dice.1: Obsidian die. Same tier as the diamond die and upgradeable from it; while equipped you gain 3 base defense and take 50%% less explosion damage.
astral_dice.guide.entry.weird_dice.1: Weird die. Same tier as the diamond die and upgradeable from it; your combat die is more likely to roll low (1-3).
astral_dice.guide.entry.crimson_dice.1: Crimson die. Same tier as the Netherite Die and upgradeable from it; your combat die is more likely to roll high (4-6), but rolling a 1 immediately deals 6 damage to you.
astral_dice.guide.entry.ender_dice.1: Ender die. Same tier as the Netherite Die and upgradeable from it; lethal damage triggers one totem-of-undying effect (followed by a 5:00 cooldown) and teleports you to safe ground within 16 blocks (no teleport while in water; a vanilla Totem of Undying trigger also teleports you), but damage taken in rain/underwater is increased by 40%%.
astral_dice.guide.entry.glass_dice.1: Glass die. Same tier as the Golden Die and upgradeable from it; your combat cards always roll their maximum, but dying destroys this die and all of its equipped cards.
astral_dice.guide.entry.nether_star_dice: Nether Star die. A new exotic T4 tier, upgradeable from any T3 die (4 Nether Stars in a cross around it); card slots and cost points are always at their maximum (12 slots / cost cap 6 each side), equippable chip count +1 (0★4/1★5/2★6/3★7); each star level grants +2 attack and +2 defense.
Netherrack die. Same tier as the Golden Die and upgradeable from it; mining ores in the Nether has a 30%% chance to drop a Star Coin and 5%% to drop a Star Plate, and piglins stay neutral to you.
astral_dice.guide.entry.dice.1: The base die. While equipped, melee attacks trigger the Dice Blessing (gain it on attack, activate dice combat while blessed, press the key to open the card inventory).
astral_dice.guide.entry.eagle_scope_chip: Hitting a target applies 1 Mark layer; deal +2 extra attack damage per Mark layer on the target.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_barr: Barricade: right-click the face of a block you are looking at to place a barricade on the aimed spot (follows vanilla placement rules, up to 4.5 blocks away (vanilla block reach)).
The barricade has 30 durability and loses exactly 1 point per creature hit (the damage value is ignored); it blocks players and mobs like a fence.

The barricade draws the aggro of non-elite, non-boss hostile mobs within an 8-block sphere: their target switches to the barricade and they attack it; it disappears when its durability runs out, it is destroyed, or 20:00 after being placed.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_repu: Reinforced Repulsion: right-click the face of a block you are looking at to place a Reinforced Repulsion on the aimed spot (follows vanilla placement rules, up to 4.5 blocks away (vanilla block reach); nothing is consumed when the spot is invalid).

A Reinforced Repulsion has 50 durability; once per second it slowly pulls the hostile mobs that currently have an aggro target and the enraged neutral mobs within 12 blocks toward itself (they cannot escape its aura; hostiles with no aggro target — such as an unprovoked Enderman — are never attached, and player pets are excluded) and keeps applying Slowness (0:10) and Weakness (0:10). Attached Creepers cannot detonate (their fuse is suppressed and the explosion is cancelled). It never draws aggro, and hostile mobs and environmental damage cannot harm it; 5 melee hits from a player send it back as an item (durability, remaining lifetime and already granted charge are kept), and placing it again restores its previous health.

Every 10 seconds it loses durability equal to the number of targets currently attached (at most 5 at a time, and nothing is spent while no target is attached — un-attracted mobs with no aggro target are not counted); when its durability runs out it shatters. This is an exclusive card usable only by its owner and belongs to the Brute Force and Supernatural sign (that sign will be added later).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_bers: Berserk: +3 attack per stack and +1 damage taken per stack (max 3 stacks) for 3:00 (re-use adds a stack and refreshes the duration). Holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick a non-hostile creature within 16 blocks; hostile mobs cannot be picked; no countdown); on confirm the target gains or stacks Berserk. Right-click to use it on yourself; putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_choc: Chocolate Cake: restores 20%% of max HP.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_dire: Directional Blast: aim at a hostile target; after 0.5s it detonates, dealing 5 magic damage (the effect-card damage bonus also applies) to it and to other targets within 6 blocks.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_expr: Express Delivery: holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick a non-hostile creature within 16 blocks; hostile mobs cannot be picked; no countdown); on confirm the target gains Speed II (1:00). Right-click to use it on yourself; putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_fate: Fate's Guide (exclusive, usable only by its owner):
Play count +1; instantly halve the current max active-skill cooldown countdown.
Deal 20%% more damage to targets with a Weak Mark for 5:00.
Saturation from all food is doubled for 5:00.
Enigmatic Legacy+ link: while wearing the Cursed Ring, correct Curse 1 — incoming doubled damage reduced by 50%% for 5:00.
Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks link: spell mana costs halved for 5:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_figh: Fight Poison with Poison: gain Poison (0:08), then remove up to 3 vanilla negative effects and gain Regeneration II (0:30) (hidden icon).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_king: King Power: take 8 damage, gain +5 attack per stack (max 3 stacks) for 3:00 (re-use adds a stack and refreshes the duration).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_livi: Living Page (exclusive, usable only by its owner):

Holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick a hostile target within 32 blocks, no countdown); on confirm the page flies at the target at high speed and always hits (blocks do not stop it), deals 2 + the number of Living Pages the Investigator has used as magic damage (affected by all spell-damage bonuses) and applies 1 Mark layer. Putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing.

While wearing the Investigator sign, each Living Page used permanently increases its damage by +1; only when the target already had 3+ Mark layers before the hit does this card cycle grant +1 card slot (hard cap of 9 per round).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_luxu: Luxury Feast: holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick a non-hostile creature within 16 blocks; hostile mobs cannot be picked; no countdown); on confirm it heals the target and friendly players within 6 blocks (teammates only when you are on a team; all players when you are not) for 30%% of your max HP; an undead target takes that amount as damage instead of being healed (vanilla behaviour). Right-click to use it on yourself; putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_mons: Monster Brick: aim at a hostile target to hurl a brick (the vanilla brick item icon, about the size of a zombie's head) above its head, which then drops straight down; on impact it deals 6 magic damage (the effect-card damage bonus also applies) with shatter particles.

Monster Laser: aim at a hostile target; after 0.5s a red laser line (infinite height) appears above it and strikes it for 4 magic damage (the effect-card damage bonus also applies). The beam lasts 1 second.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_orbi: Orbital Strike: aim at a hostile target; after 0.5s a golden beacon beam (infinite height) appears above it and strikes it for 8 magic damage (the effect-card damage bonus also applies). The beam lasts 1 second and emits glowing splash particles on hit.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_unwa: Unwavering: defense +4, up to 3 stacks, and Resistance II for 3:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_you_: You Have, I Have: holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick another player within 16 blocks, no countdown; you cannot target yourself); on confirm you and the target each gain a random card. Putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.eight_sided_dice: When a Dice Blessing triggers, roll and accumulate; every 8 total points grant +1 Starlight (capped); rolling exactly 8 grants 8 Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.fanny_sign.1: Active Skill - Event Choice: randomly draw 2 global events from the current event pool, choose 1 and trigger it; you must select one and click Confirm for it to trigger.
astral_dice.guide.entry.fanny_sign.2: (continued) If you do not choose within 15 seconds, or if you die or leave the game, the first option is triggered automatically; confirming closes the panel immediately and starts the event flow; the skill sound plays when you press the skill key.
astral_dice.guide.entry.fanny_sign.3: Passive Skill - Spot the Highlight: after you trigger an event, gain 3 Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.fen_sign.1: Active Skill - Channel Qi: for 1:00, attack +3; with Recharged Energy, heal 6 HP and gain Speed (1:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.fen_sign.2: Passive Skill - Recharged Energy: with Recharged Energy, attack/defense +2; no Blessing triggered within 1:00 → Recharged Energy +1; triggering a Blessing → -1; triggering a Blessing at 5 layers → consume 2 and immediately deal 88%% of this attack's damage (minimum 5) as true damage to hostiles within 6 blocks of the target; using a healing effect card → +1.
Killing a hostile target with at least 20 max health grants +1 Starlight; every 4 layers of Starlight grant Attack Damage +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.flashlight_burst: Attacking a target this player has never attacked grants 1 Starlight (each target counts once per player); every 2 layers of Starlight grant Attack Damage +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.fortune_stick_ch: During Dice Blessing, the first monster kill makes the wearer and friendly players within 16 blocks gain 1-7 Starlight each (the more Starlight a player has, the more likely a low roll; once per Blessing cycle).
astral_dice.guide.entry.abyss_reagent_ch: On equip, gain 2 healing layers; when healing is triggered, gain damage absorption equal to the actual healing ×2.
astral_dice.guide.entry.infinite_grid_ch: Effect card play count +1; each time charge is gained, other friendly players within 8 blocks each gain 1 charge .
astral_dice.guide.entry.sensor_chip.1: Every 3 Mark layers on an attacked target lower that target's combat dice by 1 (up to -4 points); after a successful dodge, apply 1 Mark layer to the attacker.
astral_dice.guide.entry.friendship_badge: Friendship Badge: when you apply any healing effect to a friendly player, both of you gain 2 healing layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.golden_dice.1: Golden die. A higher tier than the base die that unlocks more chip slots; card slots follow the star level only (identical across tiers at the same star).
astral_dice.guide.entry.golden_star_plat: A golden star plate for high-tier crafting; found in loot chests.
astral_dice.guide.entry.haiqing_sign.1: Active - Weakness Mark: choose a hostile target and apply §9Weakness Mark (5:00)§7 to it: damage taken §e+10%%§7 and gains Weakness.
astral_dice.guide.entry.haiqing_sign.2: Passive Skill - Lucky Star: a roll of 6 during the Dice Blessing immediately grants 6 Star Coins; when a Weak Marked target is killed, the Astrologer gains 3 Star Coins; if the killer is a player, that player gains a Fate's Guide.
astral_dice.guide.entry.hand_fan_big_chi: After using an active skill: gain a random effect card (excl. exclusive) and apply 1 Mark layer to all hostiles within range (for target-waiting signs this only triggers after the target is confirmed).
astral_dice.guide.entry.hand_fan_small_c: After using an active skill: apply 1 Mark layer to all hostiles within 16 blocks of you (for target-waiting signs this only triggers after the target is confirmed).
astral_dice.guide.entry.integration.2: Bountiful: bounty decrees can reward the mod's dice, star coins, star plates, cards, chips and signs (pure data-driven).

astral_dice.guide.entry.integration.3: Enigmatic Legacy+: Fate's Guide corrects the Cursed Ring's curses; the Guardian sign corrects Curse 4 during Burst (triggered by the active skill); the Cursed Sword tugs at the Scroll of a Thousand Curses.

astral_dice.guide.entry.jasmine_sign.1: Active Skill - Energy Overload: for 2:00, movement speed +20%% and armor -30%%, plus one random effect: Resistance (2:00) or Strength (2:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.jasmine_sign.2: Passive Skill - Motion Charge: every 300 meters moved, alternately gain +1 attack and +1 defense (each capped); using an Express Delivery card immediately reduces the active skill's max cooldown by 50%%.
astral_dice.guide.entry.komachi_sign.1: Active - Ninja Combo: this round's card slots +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.komachi_sign.2: Passive - Duplicator: after 3 effect cards are used: copy the last effect card used to your inventory; your active skill cooldown is reduced by 30%% immediately; damage effect card bonus +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.lulu_sign.1: Active Skill - Healing Slime: choose a friendly player or yourself and apply Healing Slime to them: the target gains 3 healing layers and instant healing; and, centered on the target, hostiles in range get Slowness (1:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.lulu_sign.2: Passive Skill - Cell Division: when attacked by a hostile target, gain 1 healing layer and reduce the active skill's cooldown by 10 seconds (at most once every 15 seconds).
astral_dice.guide.entry.magic_quiver_chi: After using a damage effect card and dealing ranged or magic damage to a marked target: return the effect card used this time and apply 1 Mark layer to the target. Triggers at most once every 30 seconds.

astral_dice.guide.entry.marker_sprayer_c: After dealing ranged or magic damage to a target, apply 1 Mark layer.
astral_dice.guide.entry.medkit_complete_: On equip (and again on respawn / relog / dimension change), on Dice Blessing trigger, and on every 1:00 healing settlement, gain 3 healing layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.medkit_emergency: On equip (and again on respawn / relog / dimension change), on Dice Blessing trigger, and on every 1:00 healing settlement, gain 1 healing layer.
astral_dice.guide.entry.mimi_sign.1: Active Skill - Restock: recycle all cards in your inventory and receive recycled count +1 random cards.
astral_dice.guide.entry.mimi_sign.2: Passive Skill - Recycle: when you gain a battle card through your active skill's returns, gain 1 Star Coin; while equipped, chip slots +1; every 100 battle cards returned by your active skill grants a random chip (at most 1 per use).
astral_dice.guide.entry.misaki_sign.1: Active Skill - Sakura Sky Slash: for 2:00, attack +4; dice value increased by your equipped dice's star level (1★+1, 2★+2, 3★+3); Meito damage floor increased by star level (1★+2, 2★+3, 3★+5). If Sword Qi reaches 3 layers, consume 2 to exchange for a Meito.
astral_dice.guide.entry.misaki_sign.2: Passive Skill - Sword Qi: gain 1 layer when a Dice Blessing triggers (max 3); each layer grants +1 attack, with an extra +2 at 3 layers; the Meito card's cost is reduced to 3.

astral_dice.guide.entry.nancy_lu_sign.1: Active Skill - Remote Intrusion: enter full invisibility instantly (up to 30 seconds). While invisible, attacking a hostile target and breaking invisibility immediately grants a fixed +6 attack for 2:00 (pressing the active skill itself grants no bonus, and natural expiry without an attack grants none either).
astral_dice.guide.entry.nancy_lu_sign.2: Passive Skill - Network Firewall: immune to Ender Pearl teleport damage. After a Dice Blessing ends, if there are no hostiles within 3 blocks, gain +3 attack and a random battle card; otherwise gain +3 defense.
astral_dice.guide.entry.moses_sign.1: Active Skill - Weak Counter: choose a hostile target and apply Broken (2:00) to it; if the target already has Broken, no cooldown is spent.
astral_dice.guide.entry.moses_sign.2: Passive Skill - Precision: the active cooldown is 120s while equipped; gain 1 Weakness Insight (max 4) after dodging, counterattacking, or attacking a Broken target. Each layer: attack/defense +1, minimum dice roll +1; one layer is removed every minute.
astral_dice.guide.entry.moses_sign.3: Broken effect: the target's dice can only be 0 while fighting the Gunsmith, and it is dodged and triggers a counterattack.
astral_dice.guide.entry.netherite_dice.1: Netherite die. The highest tier, unlocking the most chip slots; card slots follow the star level only (identical across tiers at the same star).
Effect card play count +1; ranged and magic damage gain bonus damage equal to the target's Mark layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.padman_sign.1: Active - Really Angry: this attack/defense roll takes the maximum value.
astral_dice.guide.entry.padman_sign.2: Passive - No Opinion: your base attack/defense roll shifts over time (-2 to 4); during Dice Blessing, rolling 6 ignores the target's Defense (including armor); rolling 1 makes your next roll 6.
astral_dice.guide.entry.papara_sign.1: Active Skill - Take a Bite: for 3:00, attacking heals half of the combat damage dealt; being attacked by a hostile target heals half of the damage received; every health-conditioned effect counts as satisfied while the active skill is active.
astral_dice.guide.entry.papara_sign.2: Passive Skill - Cuteness Is Justice: at 50%% health or below, attack/defense +3.
astral_dice.guide.entry.parunan_sign.1: Merchant Sign. Active "Online Shopping": remotely opens the Card Shop screen (buy cards, exchange Starlight, transfer Star Coins to other online players); the active applies no effect itself and starts a 120-second cooldown when worn.
astral_dice.guide.entry.parunan_sign.2: Passive "Legendary Merchant": gain 1 Star Coin each time you enter the shop; your and your team's shops stock +1 purchasable combat card; after entering, each card has a 10%% chance to drop to 1 Star Coin; after a transfer the first undiscounted card in your current shop drops to 1 Star Coin; Starlight exchange grants 50%% extra Star Coins (the enter-shop coin, the transfer discount and the exchange bonus apply to the wearer; the combat-card bonus and the discount apply to you and your team).
astral_dice.guide.entry.piercing_gun_chi: Ranged or magic damage to a target gains bonus damage equal to the target's defense points.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.1: Four playstyles, each built around its own resource and mechanics:
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.2: Starlight: produced and spent by the flashlight, eight-sided die, bank card, star-coin hammer and more — linked to the Merchant sign (Starlight exchange, +50%% extra) and the Kanban Musume sign.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.3: Healing: healing layers form a single pool provided by Medkits, the Slime sign and the Buffer Shield; triggering the Dice Blessing — and every 1:00 settlement afterwards — heals you for healing layers × 2 (each settlement halves the layers first, then the Medkit tops them up).
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.4: Marks: build around mark stacks, combined with chips like the Magic Quiver for heavy magic damage.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.5: Charge: a player-level stack resource (max 20), built up by moving, teleporting, killing and triggering the Dice Blessing (Energy Recycler, Warp Engine, Electric Sword, Perpetual Motion). While you have any Charge, sign active cooldowns are capped at 160 seconds and effect-card cooldowns at 30 seconds (the base value is capped, and other reductions such as the Weird Dice still apply); stacks also convert into attack and movement speed, or the Current Core can spend them to instantly finish a sign's active cooldown.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.6: Beyond the four playstyles, general chips such as Boxing Gloves, Speed Skates and Sandwiches belong to none of them and directly buff your stats.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.7: Coordinate with teammates to pull off combos.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.name: Playstyles
astral_dice.guide.entry.revenge_halberd_: While under any of these effects, attack +6: Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Blindness, Darkness, Wind Charged, Weaving, Oozing, Infested, Blue Curse.
While under any of these effects, defense +6: Hunger, Nausea, Poison, Wither, Raid Omen, Trial Omen, Marked.
The bonus vanishes the moment all matching effects are gone.

astral_dice.guide.entry.rin_sign.2: Passive - Investigation Findings: when you trigger or are affected by an event, gain a Living Page (wearers within 32 blocks or in your team); using a Living Page permanently increases its damage by +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.sandwich_high_ch: Max health +8; while max HP exceeds 20, gain +1 attack per 4 extra HP.
astral_dice.guide.entry.adrenaline_high_: Adrenaline (High-Grade): at 50%% health or below, attack/defense +8 (counts as satisfied while the Vampire sign's Drain is active).
While the bonus is active, being attacked by a hostile grants a 20%% chance to dodge a single attack.
astral_dice.guide.entry.adrenaline_low_c: Adrenaline (Common): at 50%% health or below, attack/defense +3 (counts as satisfied while the Vampire sign's Drain is active).
astral_dice.guide.entry.satellite_chip.1: If you hold fewer than 6 Orbital Strikes, gain one every 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.satellite_chip.2: After using an Orbital Strike, this round's play count +1, once per 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.scope_chip.1: Attack +2; hitting a target applies 1 Mark layer.
Dice Blessing: triggered by melee attacks while a dice is equipped; attack and defense clash during it, and its duration cannot be overwritten by the dice effect until it ends.
Marks: scopes, ninja stars, hand fans and more stack marks on targets; chips like the Magic Quiver resolve around marks.
Effect card states: Berserk, King Power, Unwavering and more; some are hidden-icon effects (e.g. Regeneration II from Fight Poison with Poison).
Charge: using the Charge card returns Full Power when the blessing ends.
astral_dice.guide.entry.spell_damage.1: Magic damage comes from the damage effect cards: Monster Laser, Monster Brick, Orbital Strike, Directional Blast and the Living Page.
astral_dice.guide.entry.spell_damage.2: Magic damage is affected by damage bonuses, e.g. the Ninja sign's "Damage Effect Card Bonus" passive grants +1 per 3 effect cards used.
astral_dice.guide.entry.spell_damage.3: The Magic Quiver applies 1 Mark layer and returns the effect card used this time when you deal magic damage to a marked target.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin.1: The mod's base currency, widely used in recipes and dice upgrading.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin_bag.1: A pouch of 9 Star Coins; open it to retrieve them.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin_hammer: Gain 5 Starlight on equip; after each successful Starlight exchange, Starlight is replenished by your worn Bank Cards (Low / High / Unlimited) and Star Coin Hammer - this chip counts as 5, multiple chips stack, up to 32; if you hold at least 32 Star Coins, each Dice Blessing consumes 18 Star Coins and grants 30%% of your held Star Coins as Attack Damage, up to 100 (a Star Coin Bag counts as 9; when loose coins are short it breaks open one bag, takes only the coins needed and leaves the rest in your inventory, and consumes nothing if they cannot be stored safely).
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_plate.1: A plate of solidified starlight for higher crafts. It appears in no recipe itself.
astral_dice.guide.entry.regeneration_rea: Crafting material. A reagent brimming with the power of rebirth, the base ingredient for Healing-related crafting.
Crafting material. A wire that stores and transfers energy, the base ingredient for Charge-related crafting.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin_dust.1: Crafting material. An alloy material made from Star Coins, usable in economy-related crafting.
astral_dice.guide.entry.mark_paint.1: Crafting material. Paint used to mark targets, the base ingredient for Mark-related crafting.
astral_dice.guide.entry.target_chip.1: Attack +1; after gaining a Dice Blessing, apply 1 Mark layer to the nearest hostile target other than the one you are attacking.
astral_dice.guide.entry.vitamin_pill_chi: When you obtain any card, gain +1 healing layer.
astral_dice.guide.entry.advanced_periphe: While Charge is 4 or higher, attack +4. Each Dice Blessing trigger consumes 1 Charge (it counts as a consumption, so Primordial Core converts it into 1 Empower).
astral_dice.guide.entry.big_bowl_stew_ch: After a Dice Blessing ends, you and all friendly players within 16 blocks restore 2 HP and gain 2 healing layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bookmark_chip.1: Damage effect cards gain +2 damage bonus.
astral_dice.guide.entry.current_core_chi: On using the active skill: gain 1 charge. Pressing the active skill key while it is on cooldown spends charge in proportion to the remaining cooldown and instantly finishes it (no effect without enough charge); tiers are remaining cooldown ÷ 180 s split into 6 steps (1 minimum, 6 maximum).

Pressing the active-skill key while the skill is on cooldown spends Charge based on the remaining-cooldown ratio and instantly finishes the cooldown (you must press again to cast). Cost is the remaining cooldown divided by 180 s in 6 tiers, from 1 to 6 Charge; nothing happens if Charge is insufficient.
astral_dice.guide.entry.electric_sword_c: Each 4 charge, attack +1. After killing 10 hostiles in total, charge +2.
astral_dice.guide.entry.energy_recycler_: Every 150 m traveled in total, charge +1; at 5+ Charge, movement speed +5%%.
astral_dice.guide.entry.member_recommend: When Dice Blessing triggers, if your inventory holds fewer than 5 cards, gain a random card. While equipped, all cards in your own shop cost 1 Star Coin less (stacks with the Merchant sign's discount, down to 0 Star Coins).
astral_dice.guide.entry.perpetual_motion: When Dice Blessing triggers, if your current Charge is below 8, it is topped up to 8; while equipped, the melee attack cooldown is halved.
After 2 effect cards are used, gain 3 Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.smart_watch_chip: While you hold fewer than 6 cards, each hostile kill grants a random card.
astral_dice.guide.entry.airbag_chip.1: When taking fatal damage, consume 6 charge to negate the damage (cooldown 1:00). This saving effect takes priority over the Whetstone, the Totem of Undying and the Ender Die; lethal damage that bypasses invulnerability is also negated (e.g. the /kill command); lethal damage from falling into the void cannot be negated. In addition, taking damage grants 1 charge (cooldown 15 seconds).
astral_dice.guide.entry.electric_glove_c: When you attack a target with a damage effect card, all targets within 3 blocks of it (including the main target) take 2 magic damage after a 1-second delay. Each target that takes this damage grants 1 Charge. Cooldown 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.primordial_core_: Each charge spent grants 1 Empowerment layer (max 10). Each layer grants Attack Power +1 and Defense +1, and you lose 1 layer every 0:30.
astral_dice.guide.entry.railgun_chip.1: With at least 6 charge, Attack Power +5. On a melee attack against a hostile target, after 1 second call down lightning on hostile targets within 3 blocks of the target, dealing "5 + 50%% of the triggering hit's damage" (minimum 5), then enter a 1:00 cooldown. Lightning is a separate true-damage source: it does not merge into the triggering hit and does not trigger Dice Blessing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.whetstone_chip.1: At 50%% health or below, Attack Power +4 and damage taken -2; while health is above 1, a single hit can at most reduce your health to 1 (cooldown 1:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.extra_battery_ch: While equipped, active skill cooldown is reduced by 50%% (stacks with other cooldown reductions).
astral_dice.guide.entry.warp_engine_chip: On teleport, charge +2 and gain Speed (0:10). Counted warps: ender pearl, the Ender Die's safe warp after the death totem, dimension portals, and Waystones (requires Waystones). Portals and Waystones share a 3:00 cooldown; ender pearl and Ender Die warps have no cooldown.
